verdict.rationale: Adyen's Protect module offers a rule builder to create, backtest, and label custom fraud rules, and webhooks let integrators react to payment status events, together giving a rules+events automation pattern. However this is scoped to risk/fraud management, not a general-purpose event-rule-action automation engine for arbitrary business logic. Missing for 10: evidence of a general workflow/automation rule engine beyond fraud rules, ability to trigger arbitrary custom actions (not just fraud flags) from webhook events, and any AI-native tooling connecting rule definition to automatic execution.
